SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ntc.notice_no ASC) AS rnum , ntc.notice_no , ntc.notice_type , CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(notice_title) > 50 THEN LEFT(notice_title, 50)||'...' ELSE notice_title END AS notice_title , DATE_FORMAT(ntc.notice_d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS notice_d , ntc.user_uid as notice_user_id , lvm.user_email , lvm.user_nm AS notice_user_nm , CASE WHEN ntc.answer_contents IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(ntc.answer_d, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE '' END AS answer_d , ntc.answer_user_id , CASE WHEN ntc.answer_contents IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS reply_yn , CASE WHEN ntc.notice_title = '삭제 되었습니다.' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS qna_del_yn , (SELECT ad.user_nm FROM seinfo_vendor_manager ad WHERE ad.user_email = ntc.answer_user_id) AS answer_user_nm FROM seinfo_notice ntc LEFT OUTER JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager lvm ON lvm.user_uid = ntc.user_uid WHERE ntc.notice_type = 'Q'
AND ntc.user_uid = (SELECT a.user_uid FROM seinfo_vendor_manager a WHERE a.user_email = #{userEmail} AND IFNULL(a.user_pwd_init_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND a.bl_yn = 'N' )
AND ( ntc.notice_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ntc.notice_contents LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ntc.answer_contents LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{startRow}
